keybindSetup: Uses the game's DEFAULT keybinds (verified from the EDIT KEYBINDS screen on 2026-11-06). No in-game changes needed. If the user remapped keys in-game, edit this profile to match.
note: In-game buttons: top row T1-T4 (blue) = R T Y U, bottom row B1-B4 (pink) = F G H J, lever = WASD. The color-to-row mapping (blue notes -> T row, red/pink notes -> B row) is inferred from button colors and must be confirmed on the real machine in v0.2. Coordinates are normalized to the game window and are starting values; the perspective lane geometry must also be confirmed in v0.2 before detection is enabled.
